response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptional software engineer with 20 years of proven expertise and strong craftsmanship practices. However, this role specifically requires deep C++ systems programming expertise with industrial automation and cybersecurity domain knowledge. His career has been entirely focused on web and full-stack technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) with minimal recent C++ exposure—last significant work in 2015. The resume shows no evidence of industrial automation, embedded systems development, IEC 62443 compliance, MQTT/industrial protocols, or multi-threaded systems architecture—all core to the position. The fundamental technical skill mismatch is too significant.
strengths: Exceptional seniority with 20 years of software engineering experience, far exceeding the 8-12 year requirement, demonstrating sustained career growth and adaptability
Demonstrated mastery of software craftsmanship including TDD, CI/CD, clean code principles, and event-driven architecture across multiple technology stacks
Proven mentoring and leadership capability through workshops, open-source contributions (GISCollective), and ability to quickly master diverse programming languages
concerns: Primary expertise is TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than C++; last significant C++ development was over 11 years ago with no recent application or demonstrated proficiency
Zero demonstrated experience with industrial automation, embedded systems, cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), or industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
Career trajectory is exclusively web/SaaS engineering rather than systems/embedded programming; education combines computer science and fine arts rather than engineering (B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech)

key_factors.factor: C++ systems programming expertise and currency
Industrial automation and embedded systems domain knowledge
Senior-level software engineering maturity and craftsmanship
